items.title: [ECG] NHG Health Aspiring Doctors Job Shadowing Programme (Dec 2026)
items.author: Lee Meng Choo
items.description:
Message posted on behalf of NHG Health
NHG Health is glad to announce our next Pre-U student attachment programme, now renamed to
Aspiring Doctors Job Shadowing Programme
to provide a more realistic expectation for the programme.
Following the students’ feedback in the previous runs, we have also shortened the programme duration from 2 weeks to 1 week, which doubles the number of placements we are able to offer. So this December, we will be having 2 runs:
Run 1 - 30 Nov - 4 Dec 2026 (Mon-Fri)
Run 2 - 7-11 Dec 2026 (Mon-Fri)
This programme is open to your students who may be keen to find out and experience the realities of being a doctor in the public healthcare landscape by shadowing clinicians in their daily work. Successful applicants will be offered job shadowing placements in various NHG institutions, such as Tan Tock Seng Hospital, Khoo Teck Puat Hospital, Woodlands Hospital, NHG Polyclinics, etc.
More information about this programme is available on our
website
and interested students may submit the
online application form
by
Friday, 9 October 2026, 6pm
.

items.title: [VIA] 📢 VOLUNTEERS WANTED: Project Beyond Barriers! 🌟
items.author: Wang Jingwei
items.description:
Hey Hwa Chongians!
Looking for a meaningful Service Learning opportunity to make a direct impact while having fun? Join us for
Project Beyond Barriers
, a VIA project in collaboration with
FaithActs
where we engage primary school children through movement games, agility relays, and teamwork challenges!
Project Overview & Objectives
Partner Agency:
FaithActs
Address:
Blk 50 Commonwealth Drive #01-506
Target Beneficiaries:
6 to 15 children
Volunteers Needed:
10 to 15 volunteers
(1:3 volunteer-to-child ratio for close supervision)
VIA Hours:
2 Hours Per Session
Session Dates & Schedule For 2026
Session 1:
6 October 2026, 4:00pm – 5:30pm
Session 2:
20 October 2026, 4:00pm – 5:30pm
Session 3:
3 November 2026, 4:00pm – 5:30pm
Session 4:
17 November 2026, 4:00pm – 5:30pm
Session 5:
1 December 2026, 4:00pm – 5:30pm
Session 6:
15 December 2026, 4:00pm – 5:30pm
Session 7:
29 December 2026, 4:00pm – 5:30pm
What You Will Be Doing
:
Some activities planned include: (not exhaustive)
Trust & Balance Stations:
Guide low-impact spatial awareness activities where children learn active listening and peer guidance.
Agility & Relays:
Lead energetic movement games focused on coordination, sportsmanship, and positive peer encouragement.
Strategy & Puzzles:
Coach small groups through multi-stage obstacle challenges and tactical team problem-solving.
Reflection & Facilitation:
Lead short group debriefs to help children articulate learnings on resilience, communication, and growth.
What’s in it for You?
Verified VIA Hours:
Official service hours tracked for your school portfolio and graduation requirements.
Leadership & Facilitation Experience:
Gain real-world experience in active supervision, small-group mentoring, and conflict resolution.
High Impact, Low Stress:
Work in small teams with a 1:3 ratio so you can build genuine connections with the kids.
Who We Are Looking For
Patient, energetic, and responsible Hwa Chong students.
Comfortable engaging with children and leading simple physical/indoor games.
Able to commit to the session dates listed above.
How to Apply
Ready to make an impact beyond the classroom? Sign up now!
👉

Sign-up Link Here

[25/09/2026]
For any inquiries, feel free to reach out to
Kevin Neo, Xu Miaofei, Qiu Yucheng or Zhu Litian
via school email or Google chat!
See you on the team! 🔥

items.title: CCA Appreciation Week
items.author: Tan Yee Weal
items.description:
Hey Hwachong! We are the 15th CCA Council, and we are pleased to announce our annual initiative, CCA Appreciation Week (CCAAW) will be held next week from 31 August - 4 September, T3W10 Monday to Friday.
Behind every CCA achievement, every medal, every performance, every event, every late-night practice, here's a quiet army making it all possible. Our CCA Teachers-in-Charge, Coaches, and Instructors who pour their time and expertise into shaping us. Our non-teaching staff, security guards, lab staff, cleaners, canteen staff, estate staff, and our admin and finance teams, who keep our school running safely and smoothly, often without a word of thanks. And our alumni associations and Parent Support Group, who continue to give back to the school they love.
They are The Amazing Avengers of Hwa Chong. This week, it's our turn to make sure they know it.
This year, we're bringing you the Infinity Stones of Hwa Chong 💎, because just like the Avengers needed all six stones to save the universe, HC needs all our Infinity Stones to keep running smoothly!
🟣Power — Dedication (Security Guards)
🔵Space — Keeping Everything Running (Estate Workers/Cleaners)
🔴Reality — Making Our School Better (Admin & Finance)
🟡Mind — Care & Understanding (TICs)
🟢Time — Years of Service (Cleaners)
🟠Soul — The Heart of Hwa Chong (Canteen Vendors)
You can find us at Inner Plaza throughout the week! Do drop by our two booths to learn more about the non-teaching staff who keep Hwa Chong running behind the scenes and show them some appreciation! You can also explore our Avenger inspired activities and help us piece together the full set, because it takes all six to make HC complete! 🦸
And that's not all — join us at the Inner Plaza after school on Tuesday for a series of interactive activities and games:
🍳 Cook Off  — Teams of 2 race the clock to serve up dishes, Cooking Fever style
🕵️ Security Check — Suspicious characters, sketchy bags, and your best detective instincts
🧹 Putt and Sort — Sweep, sort, and help us recycle while you're at it
🎭 Mystery Bag — Reach in, guess what you're holding, and act it out for your team
🧡 An interactive Gratitude Wall
📸 Heartfelt Instagram features by CCAC
🎤 Candid interviews with our non-teaching staff and students
And of course, don’t forget CCA Shirt Day on Tuesday (1st September)!👚You’re encouraged to wear your official CCA shirt, team jersey or school polo-T to celebrate the different CCA communities across Hwa Chong. Do remember that your shirt must be school-approved and have the school logo and/or “Hwa Chong” name clearly visible for security purposes.
This is more than a week of activities.
It's a chance to pause, notice, and say thank you to the people who make our CCA journey possible.
More details dropping soon through your CCALs and right here on our page. Stay tuned, and don't forget to follow @hcccas so you don't miss a thing! 💛
See you there!
15th CCA Council
